_about: FamGenie's affiliate and sponsor registry. Terms were read from each source page on checkedOn; re-check before applying. 'status' is the owner's sign-up state: only the owner can apply (it needs their identity, tax form and bank details). Placements are parent-facing only: never on the kid pages (/c/, /k/) or in texts to children. Usage assumptions are planning guesses, not measurements; replace them with real numbers from marketing/results.md once links are live.

programs.name: Greenlight
programs.network: FlexOffers listing (not currently offered there); apply direct
programs.placement: Money screen: 'Want a card for allowances? FamGenie works with the apps you already use.'
programs.note: FamGenie still never holds or moves money; this is a link out only. Confirm the payout when applying.

programs.name: Varsity Tutors
programs.network: FlexOffers listing (not currently offered there); apply direct
programs.placement: Family inbox, under a tutor thread: 'Need another tutor?'
programs.note: assumedOrderUsd is a guess; set it from the first real reports.

programs.name: Outschool
programs.placement: Schedules: 'Find a class for this week's free afternoon'
programs.note: Awin says 'up to 20%'; the plan uses 10% to stay conservative.

programs.name: KiwiCo
programs.note: $20 is the top rate for a renewing subscription on a content site; store orders pay 10%.

programs.name: Care.com
programs.note: $16 per premium subscription, $0.80 per free sign-up.

programs.name: Gabb Wireless
programs.placement: Family screen when a child has no phone number yet
programs.note: 13% is the bottom of the 13 to 30% tier.

programs.name: Amazon Associates
programs.placement: Schedules: supply lists and birthday-gift picks
programs.note: Toys and baby 3%, books 4.5%; 3.5% is a blend. The rate page does not state the cookie window; check the operating agreement.

programs.name: Bark (bark.us)
programs.note: Bark reads children's messages. That conflicts with FamGenie's no-covert-tracking rule and brand.json's forbidden 'read their messages'. The owner decides.

sponsors._about: One sponsor card per screen at most, parent-facing, labeled 'Sponsored'. Sold flat per month; nothing is counted in the income model until a deal is signed.

slots.rule: Contextual by topic only (for example back-to-school), never by a child's data
List of partner offers with the affiliate disclosure
No ad scripts; a static image and a /go link
